annotations.text:
SCHEMATICS — a site whose whole fabric is a double helix in permanent rotation.

Three directions for how the helix inhabits the page (A Spine, B Margin rail, C The Unwinding). C is drawn up as sheet 01 because it is the only one where the rotation carries meaning rather than decoration: scroll far enough and the helix performs the central dogma on itself.

Everything here is turning right now. Nothing on these sheets is a still.

PICK A DIRECTION AND I'LL BUILD IT.

A and B are deliberately low-fi — enough to choose from, not finished work. If C is right, sheets 02 / 05 are already the build spec: the strands are one CSS transform, the base pairs are one keyframe with a per-row negative delay, and no JavaScript runs per frame.
